findings.title: Documented API Interface
findings.description: REST endpoints exist via Rails controller (index, create, show) but are completely undocumented. No routes file, no API documentation.
findings.gap: No documentation describing available endpoints, parameters, or response formats.
findings.recommendation: Document all endpoints in an OpenAPI 3.x specification.

findings.title: Idempotent Write Operations
findings.description: Create endpoint has no idempotency key support. Duplicate submissions create duplicate orders and duplicate payment charges.
findings.gap: No idempotency mechanism on write endpoints.
findings.recommendation: Implement idempotency key support on all write endpoints.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND no idempotency keys on write endpoints.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: The create action performs Order.new and charge_card with no idempotency protection. Write-enabled agents will duplicate orders on retry.

blocker_remediation.immediate: Add idempotency key header support to the create endpoint.
blocker_remediation.target_state: All write endpoints enforce idempotency keys within a configurable window.

findings.title: Machine Identity Authentication
findings.description: No authentication mechanism exists. Controller explicitly documents missing auth. Any caller can invoke any endpoint.
findings.gap: No machine identity authentication. Agent identity cannot be established or attributed.
findings.recommendation: Implement OAuth2 client credentials or API key authentication with principal attribution.

findings.title: Immutable Audit Logging
findings.description: No audit logging exists. Write operations (order creation, payment charging) have zero audit trail.
findings.gap: Cannot prove compliance or attribute actions to specific callers.
findings.recommendation: Implement immutable audit logging with principal attribution for all write operations.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND no audit logging on write operations.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: The create action and charge_card method perform write operations with no logging. Write-enabled agents require full audit attribution.

blocker_remediation.immediate: Add structured logging of every write operation with principal identity.
blocker_remediation.target_state: Immutable, tamper-evident audit logs for all write operations.

findings.title: Compensation and Rollback
findings.description: Order creation and payment charging are separate non-transactional steps. Payment failure after order save leaves inconsistent state.
findings.gap: No compensation or rollback for multi-step operations.
findings.recommendation: Wrap in database transaction with rollback on payment failure. Implement saga pattern.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND no rollback for multi-step write workflows.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: The create action saves an order then charges the card. A payment failure leaves an orphaned order. Write-enabled agents executing this workflow leave inconsistent state.

blocker_remediation.immediate: Wrap order+payment in a database transaction with rollback on charge failure.
blocker_remediation.target_state: Saga pattern with compensation for all multi-step operations.

findings.title: Sensitive Data Classification
findings.description: System stores payment card data. API responses expose card_number and card_exp without filtering. No access control differentiation.
findings.gap: Agent-facing API responses expose raw PCI-scoped payment card data without field-level filtering.
findings.recommendation: Exclude sensitive fields from API responses. Tokenize card data. Implement access differentiation.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND B1 fired (sensitive fields returned in API responses).
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: DATA-Q1 B1 fired because Order.find returns all fields including card_number and card_exp to any caller. Write-enabled scope escalates to BLOCKER.

b1.reasoning: Order.find(params[:id]) returns all fields including card_number, card_exp. No serialization exclusions.

b2.reasoning: No access control differentiation — all callers get all data.

b3.reasoning: No classification metadata, tags, or PII detection tooling.

blocker_remediation.immediate: Add serialization exclusions for card_number and card_exp from API responses.
blocker_remediation.target_state: Sensitive fields excluded from all general-purpose responses. Card data tokenized.

findings.title: Data Residency and Sovereignty
findings.description: PCI-DSS scoped card data stored in MySQL on EC2 with no residency controls or compliance boundaries.
findings.gap: No controls preventing regulated data transmission to non-compliant regions.
findings.recommendation: Classify residency requirements. Tokenize card data. Enforce compliance boundaries via IaC.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND PCI-scoped data with no residency controls.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: The system stores payment card data (card_number, card_exp) in MySQL with no region enforcement. A write-enabled agent could transmit this data to LLM providers in non-compliant jurisdictions.

blocker_remediation.immediate: Classify data residency requirements. Implement network-level egress controls.
blocker_remediation.target_state: Data residency boundaries enforced via IaC. Card data tokenized.

findings.title: Scoped Permissions (Least Privilege)
findings.description: No authorization model exists. All endpoints equally accessible to any caller.
findings.gap: Cannot grant agent read-only access without also granting write access.
findings.recommendation: Implement RBAC with read-only and read-write role separation.

findings.title: Action-Level Authorization
findings.description: No action-level authorization. All actions (index, create, show) are equally accessible.
findings.gap: Cannot enforce read-but-not-create for an agent identity.
findings.recommendation: Add before_filter authorization checks per action.

findings.title: Identity Propagation and Delegation
findings.description: No identity propagation mechanism. No JWT, no token exchange, no user context.
findings.gap: Cannot distinguish agent-as-self from agent-on-behalf-of-user.
findings.recommendation: Implement OAuth2 token-based identity propagation.

compensating_controls: JWT-based identity propagation at API Gateway

findings.title: Credential Management
findings.description: Payment gateway credentials hardcoded in config/payment.yml committed to source control.
findings.gap: Live credentials exposed in repository. No rotation capability.
findings.recommendation: Migrate to AWS Secrets Manager with rotation. Rotate exposed credentials immediately.

compensating_controls: Move to environment variables as interim

findings.title: Agent Identity Suspension
findings.description: No identity system exists so no mechanism to suspend or revoke agent identities.
findings.gap: Cannot isolate misbehaving agents without taking down the application.
findings.recommendation: Implement API key authentication with per-key revocation capability.

findings.title: Concurrency Controls
findings.description: No optimistic or pessimistic locking. No version fields, ETags, or conditional writes.
findings.gap: Concurrent agent instances can corrupt state without detection.
findings.recommendation: Add optimistic locking (lock_version column) and ETag-based conditional updates.

compensating_controls: Database-level unique constraints on business keys

findings.title: Circuit Breakers and Resilience
findings.description: External SOAP payment gateway call with no circuit breaker, retry logic, or timeout.
findings.gap: Payment gateway outage cascades to all order operations.
findings.recommendation: Implement circuit breaker with timeout on payment gateway integration.

findings.title: Rate Limiting and Throttling
findings.description: No rate limiting at any layer. Application directly exposed with no traffic control.
findings.gap: Runaway agent loops can overwhelm the application at machine speed.
findings.recommendation: Deploy API Gateway or WAF with per-caller rate limiting.

findings.title: Blast Radius and Transaction Limits
findings.description: No per-caller transaction limits. No business-domain caps on operation scope.
findings.gap: Agents can create unlimited orders and trigger unlimited charges.
findings.recommendation: Implement per-caller transaction limits (max orders/hour, max spend/session).

findings.title: PII Redaction in Logs
findings.description: System processes card data with no log scrubbing or PII masking. Rails default logging exposes parameters.
findings.gap: No PII redaction mechanism for payment card data in logs.
findings.recommendation: Configure Rails parameter filtering for card_number, card_exp. Implement PII masking.

findings.title: Draft/Pending State
findings.description: All writes immediately committed. No draft/pending state for review before finalization.
findings.gap: Agent cannot propose without immediately committing and charging.
findings.recommendation: Implement draft/pending state for orders with explicit confirmation step.

findings.title: Configurable Approval Gates
findings.description: No approval workflow. All operations execute immediately without review.
findings.gap: Cannot require human approval for high-risk operations.
findings.recommendation: Implement configurable approval gates for high-value operations.

compensating_controls: Order value threshold triggering manual review

findings.title: Machine-Readable API Specification
findings.description: No OpenAPI, Swagger, AsyncAPI, GraphQL schema, or Smithy files found.
findings.gap: Agent tool definitions must be manually authored from source code.
findings.recommendation: Create an OpenAPI 3.x specification documenting all endpoints.

compensating_controls: Code analysis tools for route extraction

findings.title: Structured Error Responses
findings.description: Error responses are HTML pages, not structured data. No error codes or machine-readable bodies.
findings.gap: Agents cannot distinguish retriable from terminal errors.
findings.recommendation: Implement JSON error responses with error_code, message, retryable fields.

findings.title: Asynchronous Operation Support
findings.description: Synchronous SOAP payment gateway call with no async patterns or background jobs.
findings.gap: Long-running payment operations block requests and risk agent timeouts.
findings.recommendation: Implement async payment processing with status polling endpoint.

findings.title: Graceful Degradation Signaling
findings.description: No health endpoints, degradation headers, or fallback metadata.
findings.gap: Agents cannot detect degraded operation mode.
findings.recommendation: Implement health endpoint with granular dependency status and degradation headers.

findings.title: Sandbox/Staging Environment
findings.description: No staging environment. Payment config in live mode only. Deployment to production EC2 only.
findings.gap: No safe environment to test agent behavior before production.
findings.recommendation: Create staging environment with sandbox payment gateway.

findings.title: Selective Query Support
findings.description: Status filter exists but no pagination, result size limits, or cursor navigation.
findings.gap: Unbounded result sets on list queries exhaust LLM context windows.
findings.recommendation: Implement pagination with result size caps.

findings.title: Input Validation and Schema Enforcement
findings.description: No input validation. SQL injection via string interpolation. Mass assignment without attr_accessible.
findings.gap: System accepts arbitrary input without validation. Critical security vulnerabilities.
findings.recommendation: Parameterize SQL queries. Add attr_accessible. Implement input validation.

findings.title: Temporal Metadata and Freshness
findings.description: created_at field exists but no freshness signaling or timezone handling visible.
findings.gap: Agents cannot reason about data freshness.
findings.recommendation: Expose timestamps in responses with Cache-Control headers.

findings.title: Schema Versioning and API Contracts
findings.description: No API versioning, changelog, contract tests, or migration files.
findings.gap: Agent tool schemas break silently on API changes.
findings.recommendation: Implement API versioning and breaking change detection in CI.

findings.title: Distributed Tracing and Structured Logging
findings.description: No tracing, structured logging, or correlation IDs. Only default Rails logging.
findings.gap: Agent-initiated request failures cannot be diagnosed.
findings.recommendation: Implement OpenTelemetry with structured JSON logging and correlation IDs.

findings.title: Alerting on Error Rates and Latency
findings.description: No alerting configuration. No monitoring infrastructure.
findings.gap: System degradation undetected; agents cascade failures.
findings.recommendation: Implement CloudWatch alarms on error rates and latency.

findings.title: Infrastructure Governance
findings.description: No Infrastructure as Code. All infrastructure manually provisioned.
findings.gap: Integration surface not defined as code. No review or drift detection.
findings.recommendation: Define infrastructure as Terraform or CloudFormation with PR review.

compensating_controls: IaC migration starting with critical resources

findings.title: CI/CD with API Contract Testing
findings.description: No CI/CD pipeline. Deployment via Capistrano 2 only.
findings.gap: API changes not caught before reaching production.
findings.recommendation: Implement CI/CD pipeline with automated API contract testing.

findings.title: Rollback Capability
findings.description: Only Capistrano basic rollback (manual SSH). No automated rollback.
findings.gap: Cannot quickly roll back agent-breaking deployments.
findings.recommendation: Implement automated rollback with deployment health checks.

findings.title: API Test Coverage
findings.description: Stale Test::Unit suite that no longer runs. Zero working test coverage.
findings.gap: No automated verification of API behavior.
findings.recommendation: Implement automated API tests for critical endpoints.

compensating_controls: Minimal smoke tests for critical endpoints

findings.title: Encryption at Rest
findings.description: MySQL on EC2 with no encryption. Card data stored in plaintext.
findings.gap: Sensitive data unencrypted at rest.
findings.recommendation: Enable EBS encryption and field-level encryption for card data.

findings.title: Structured Response Format
findings.description: Application serves HTML responses via Rails views, not structured JSON.
findings.gap: HTML responses require transformation for agent consumption.
findings.recommendation: Add JSON response capability via respond_to blocks or dedicated API controllers.

findings.title: Event Emission for State Changes
findings.description: No event emission. No webhooks, SNS/SQS/EventBridge, or CDC pipelines.
findings.gap: Agents must poll for state changes; no proactive notification.
findings.recommendation: Implement event publishing for order state transitions.

findings.title: Rate Limit Documentation and Headers
findings.description: No rate limits documented or enforced. No rate limit headers.
findings.gap: Agents have no self-throttling signals.
findings.recommendation: Implement rate limiting and expose standard rate limit headers.

findings.title: Data Quality Awareness
findings.description: No data quality scoring, completeness metrics, or monitoring.
findings.gap: No visibility into data quality issues affecting agent reasoning.
findings.recommendation: Implement data quality monitoring for critical order fields.

findings.title: Data Catalog / Metadata Layer
findings.description: No data catalog, metadata layer, or schema documentation.
findings.gap: Agent tool builders must reverse-engineer the data model from code.
findings.recommendation: Document the data model with field descriptions and semantics.

evaluations.title: Queryable Current State
evaluations.reason: Current state is queryable via show (single order by ID) and index (orders by status) actions.

evaluations.title: Semantically Meaningful Field Names
evaluations.reason: Field names are semantically meaningful (status, card_number, card_exp, total, created_at). No legacy abbreviations.

evaluations.title: Business Outcome Metrics
evaluations.reason: No metrics or telemetry surface exists — informational signal, no finding emitted.

items.summary: Resolve all 7 BLOCKERs and critical RISK-SAFETY findings. Focus on authentication foundation, data protection, and write safety before any agent integration.
Address remaining RISK-SAFETY items and RISK-QUALITY findings that improve agent effectiveness and operational maturity.
Address remaining quality and informational items to maximize agent effectiveness.

recommended_actions.rationale: Authentication is the foundation — all other security controls depend on knowing who is calling.

recommended_actions.action: Tokenize payment card data and enforce field-level filtering
recommended_actions.rationale: PCI-scoped data exposed in API responses and stored unencrypted. Immediate compliance risk.
Write operations have no audit trail. Cannot detect or diagnose issues with agent-initiated actions.

recommended_actions.action: Add write safety controls (idempotency, transactions, rate limits)
recommended_actions.rationale: Write operations lack idempotency, transaction safety, and rate protection. Agent retries cause duplicate charges.

recommended_actions.action: Create documented JSON API with OpenAPI specification
recommended_actions.rationale: Current HTML interface is not machine-consumable. Agents need documented JSON APIs.
No IaC, no CI/CD, no automated rollback. Infrastructure is manually managed.
